scope.reviewMethod: Read the complete actual code and text files in bounded tool outputs. The initial combined business output was truncated; PhotoScene, QuestionScene, README and Shared were reopened in full. All other listed source outputs were complete. Natural Earth JSON was parsed in full and every coordinate traversed instead of printing all numeric literals.

Reviewing new moving renders from these legacy branches
Font, artwork or aesthetic user approval

latestUserPreference: 14 November 2026: prioritize economic content, readable Vietnamese typography, and a stationary character with gentle narration-cued turns. This explicitly supersedes earlier character acting requirements for this new film.

historicalStatus.status: The 50-second output was approved on 11 November. Later photo priority and no-branding requirements limit transfer to new films.
Five-minute output rejected on 12 November for too few online images and too much 3D. Retain as an archive, not the default.
New ten-minute output pending feedback. Praise of the earlier grocery film did not approve this business film.

R03 visual revision pending actual user feedback. This source review does not promote it to user-approved.

activeFiltering.allow: Neutral timing and source contracts, short arithmetic with units, proper contain fitting and native clip playback.
activeFiltering.condition: Require a new manifest, exact narration take, local Vietnamese font loading, current-topic semantics and rendered inspection.

activeFiltering.exclude: Historical branding, the default old Root, unrelated trade/AI/China claims or assets, and dominant repeated geometry/conveyor/donut compositions.
activeFiltering.condition: Retain all historical files and exports; filter active imports and usage only.

activeFiltering.cast: Stationary character with small turns at narration cues.
activeFiltering.condition: Do not restore walking, bobbing or lip movement simply because older branches contain those actions.

concreteFindings.impact: Hardcoded TYRANNO / EXPLAINED would violate the current unbranded-film requirement. The active economy entry does not import these components.

Mixed system fonts without local readiness can change Vietnamese text metrics. Tight line-height and character-count wrapping cannot replace the current Be Vietnam Pro loading gate and actual frame inspection.
Historical AI bars, China values and source-note IDs are coupled to specific scripts. Changing labels alone can create unsupported claims.
Eighteen wrappers share one Scene/Objects grammar. Do not describe their names as eighteen independently developed visual treatments.
These are SVG 2D/isometric drawings, not real moving footage or Three.js 3D. They explain marked illustrative mechanisms and do not establish photographed facts.
Credits, photo panel titles and cut alignment do not prove claim relevance. Hardcoded location labels must stay bound to the verified source asset.
